content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your postcode?
And what is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I can't do it today, but I can pay the full amount on December thirty-first.
Thursday 31 December 2026 is not a business day. Could you pay 900.00 on the next business day, Sunday 3 January 2027?
Yes, January third is fine, I'll pay the 900 then.
To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Sunday 3 January 2027. Do you confirm these details?
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Sunday 3 January 2027. Your promise receipt will be available in the secure inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks for your help.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
